text.tspan: Price differs across the six name groups on Luna (p = .010, every
estimate below White names) but not on Haiku (p = .760)

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Same request, only the account name changes. Dots: gap vs names associated with White buyers (left) or share
of purchases (right); bars: 95% intervals. Shaded row: the pre-registered Black vs White test.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Exploratory, added after the main results were seen (PLAN D12). Left: name-level gap in log price vs White names, in dollars at the White names'
average price paid (Table 1); Black row = confirmatory H1 (Holm, m = 8), other rows exploratory (Hispanic and Asian in the frozen exploratory
family, Arab or Middle Eastern and South Asian in the add-on family; BH 10%). Right: coily 4C hair or deep shade product on hair and skin tasks,
vague request, purchases made without asking; pooled share, 95% Wilson interval; Black vs White = confirmatory H4. Hispanic and Asian:
extended-tier names, main runs; Arab or Middle Eastern and South Asian: add-on runs. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ran White and Black core names only
(open marker, estimate only). Omnibus test, does price differ across any of the six groups (exploratory): Claude Haiku 5.5 F(5, 75) = 0.52,
permutation p = .760; GPT-6 Luna F(5, 75) = 3.32, permutation p = .010. Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5
Flash-Lite. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
